name: TA_FFM-Tohoku
description: Geo-INQUIRE TA Project FFM-Tohoku (C3-TA2-541-11-3). Mesh and results for five different rupture models. The five models used are described in the README file and generated with SeisSol on Leonardo@CINECA. Related publication: `Dynamic Viability of Finite-Fault Slip Models with Ensemble Kalman Inversion by Wong et al.
